name: Bonitasaura
sum: Bonitasaura is a titanosaur from the Santonian Bajo de la Carpa Formation of Rio Negro, Argentina, with a keratin beak sheath that sheared plants.
wsnote: The skeleton is from a sub-adult; no size figure was read.
holotype: Not read in the sources consulted; a partial sub-adult skeleton.
material: Known from a partial sub-adult skeleton and its skull.
biology: A keratin sheath on the jaw worked like a guillotine to crop vegetation raked in by peg-like front teeth; the low long skull converges with diplodocids.
author: Apesteguía 2004
